raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 7, Reason for Mistake: The Planner inverted the comparison despite having the correct birth dates—claiming Marco Ferreri (born 1928) was born later than Laurent Tirard (born 1967), leading to the wrong film selection (it should be Return Of The Hero).
